title: Why Japanese People Use Umbrellas in Light Rain
seo_title: Why Japanese People Use Umbrellas in Light Rain
description: In Japan, a light rain often means umbrellas—cheap convenience-store vinyl ones included—because commutes, humidity, and crowded trains make damp clothes a whole-day problem. Not everyone does this, and it is not a mystery.
